title: Understanding Logistic Regression
text: Logistic regression predicts the probability that a given input point belongs to a particular class. The model uses the logistic function to map predicted values to probabilities.

title: Model Parameters
text: The model parameters given are \( \hat{\theta}=(-3,1,\frac{1}{2}) \). These represent the intercept and coefficients for the features \( $$x_1$$ \) and \( $$x_2$$ \).

title: Calculating the Linear Combination
text: To find the linear combination for \( x_{new}=(1,4) \), use the formula: \( $$\theta_0$$ + $$\theta_1 x_1$$ + $$\theta_2 x_2$$ \).

title: Applying the Logistic Function
text: The logistic function is \( \sigma(z) $$=$$ \frac{1}{1+e**{-z}} \). Use this to convert the linear combination into a probability.
